The JSON archive preserves SVG source bytes and the default icon subset from
GPUI Kit commit87d10ae5e1299d1be18670a37570c5402f952e34, the frozen0.7.1 comparison.
It contains1830 names: Lucide1.43.0 plus retained GPUI Kit compatibility assets.
The default_names list is authoritative for the lightweight default bundle;
applications may opt into the complete bundle or provide assets on demand.
Combined upstream license notices are retained in LICENSE. This archive contains
software assets only; no website prose, screenshots or branding were imported.
